display_long_description:
Build your next adventure in Rigventure, a physics-based vehicle-building sandbox made for VR.

Combine modular parts, wheels, engines, hinges, pistons, and wings to create machines that drive, climb, carry, and fly. Build a practical rover, experiment with a flying contraption, or invent something entirely your own.
- Build and customize: Assemble vehicles from structural and mechanical components. Experiment with different layouts and discover what works.
- Solve engineering challenges: Design machines to navigate difficult terrain, move cargo, and overcome obstacles.
- Race your creations: Test your custom vehicles on racing circuits and sprint courses, then refine their handling.
- Visit the test park: Put steering, suspension, climbing ability, and other vehicle capabilities to the test.
- Create freely: Explore your ideas in free-build mode without a mission objective.
Every test is a chance to improve. Adjust the balance, rethink a mechanism, or rebuild from the ground up. Discover the satisfaction of turning an idea into a working machine.

Explore colourful, stylized environments and find your own solutions through hands-on building in VR.

Build. Test. Explore.
